project_context.domain: Super-App / Ride Hailing Mobile Web App
project_context.archetype_reasoning: A ride-hailing map view demands absolute clarity, objective functional hierarchy, and instantaneous readability under physical stress (walking, sunlight). Swiss High-Contrast maximizes contrast against a visually complex map, addressing the user's specific complaint about bad legibility ('Das kann man nicht sehen').

typography.rules: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) on headings, high weight contrast (Black vs Light). Never use Inter or generic sans. Label texts must be uppercase, tiny, and wide-spaced.

spacing.padding: Generous. Use p-6 inside the bottom sheet, gap-4 for lists.
spacing.layout: Mobile-first absolute positioning. Map z-0, Pills z-10, Bottom Sheet z-20.

image_urls.description: Aerial dark map view for fallback when interactive map is loading or fails.

map_layer.instructions: Render map fallback image with object-cover and opacity-80 to ensure UI pops.

gps_status_pill.structure: absolute top-safe-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-10 rounded-full px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-2
gps_status_pill.instructions: Apply floating_pill surface. Use a pulsing green dot (w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-success animate-pulse) next to text 'Standort genau' (text-xs font-bold text-zinc-800). Fallback state: orange dot 'GPS wird gesucht...'.

bottom_sheet.structure: absolute bottom-0 w-full z-20 pt-6 pb-12 px-6 flex flex-col gap-6
bottom_sheet.instructions: Apply bottom_sheet surface. Top must have a visual drag handle (w-12 h-1.5 bg-zinc-200 rounded-full mx-auto mb-2). Main content: H1 'Wohin soll\'s gehen?'.

quick_actions_toggle.instructions: Segmented control for Now/Later. 'Jetzt' (active: bg-white shadow-sm text-zinc-900 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full font-bold text-sm) vs 'Später' (inactive: text-zinc-500 px-4 py-1.5 font-medium text-sm).

destination_search_input.structure: flex items-center gap-3 bg-zinc-100 rounded-2xl p-4 w-full transition-transform active:scale-[0.98]
destination_search_input.instructions: Use Phosphor 'MagnifyingGlass' icon (size 24, text-zinc-500). Text should be text-lg text-zinc-500 'Ziel suchen...'.

saved_places.instructions: List of places (Zuhause, Arbeit). Each item is flex row, items-center, gap-4, py-4, border-b border-zinc-100 last:border-none. Icon container: w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 flex items-center justify-center. Use Phosphor 'House' and 'Briefcase'.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL @phosphor-icons/react using yarn and use it for icons (MapPin, House, Briefcase, MagnifyingGlass).
Do NOT use generic 'Inter' font. Use 'Chivo' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body. Import them via Google Fonts.
Adhere strictly to the Swiss High-Contrast color palette (Black, White, Zinc-100, and International Klein Blue #002FA7 for accents).

The user complained 'Das kann man nicht sehen gar nix sehen' - meaning the old design had terrible contrast against the map. Ensure the bottom sheet is entirely opaque, white, with crisp black text, and floating elements use strong crystal glassmorphism.
Do not use Shadcn card for the bottom sheet. Build it cleanly with tailwind HTML (div, section) to get the exact rounded-t-[32px] and shadow specs.
Use 100dvh for container height and safe-area padding equivalents (e.g., pb-8 or iOS safe area inset classes) for bottom sheet to look premium on iPhones.
Make sure all interactive items have data-testid attributes.
Ensure German language is used exactly as specified (Zuhause, Arbeit, Wohin soll\'s gehen?, Jetzt, Später, Standort genau, Ziel suchen...).
